body:
# 学! (Learn) - Minecraft英语学习模组
# 学! (Learn) - Minecraft English Learning Mod
## 简介
"学!(Learn)"是一个专为Minecraft 1.20.1设计的英语学习模组，将语言学习融入游戏体验中，轻松学习英语单词。

## Introduction
"学! (Learn)" is an English learning mod specifically designed for Minecraft 1.20.1, integrating language learning into the gaming experience for easy English word learning.

## 核心功能
## Core Features
### 1. 单词学习系统
- 随机单词展示 ：每次打开学习界面都会随机展示一个未学习的单词
- 详细单词信息 ：包含英文拼写、音标、词性、中文翻译、同义词和英文释义
- 学习状态管理 ：可将单词标记为"已学会"或"未学会"（加入错题本）
- 自动连续学习 ：标记单词后自动加载下一个单词，实现连续学习流
### 1. Word Learning System
- Random Word Display ：Each time the learning interface is opened, a random unlearned word is displayed
- Detailed Word Information ：Includes English spelling, phonetic transcription, part of speech, Chinese translation, synonyms, and English definitions
- Learning Status Management ：Words can be marked as "Learned" or "Not Learned" (added to error book)
- Automatic Continuous Learning ：Automatically loads the next word after marking, enabling a continuous learning flow
### 2. 复习系统
- 已学会单词复习 ：专门的复习界面查看所有已学会的单词
- 单词轮换浏览 ：支持上一个/下一个单词的轮换浏览（最后一个的下一个是第一个）
- 答案显示控制 ：可随时显示/隐藏单词的详细信息
### 2. Review System
- Learned Word Review ：Dedicated review interface to view all learned words
- Word Rotation Browsing ：Supports rotating browsing of previous/next words (the next of the last one is the first)
- Answer Display Control ：Can show/hide detailed word information at any time
### 3. 错题本系统
- 错题收集 ：自动收集标记为"未学会"的单词
- 错题管理 ：可从错题本中删除已掌握的单词
- 错题轮换 ：支持错题的循环浏览和复习
### 3. Error Book System
- Error Collection ：Automatically collects words marked as "Not Learned"
- Error Management ：Can delete mastered words from the error book
- Error Rotation ：Supports cyclic browsing and review of error words
### 4. 界面与交互
- 美观的GUI设计 ：半透明背景框、彩色文字、动画效果
- 中英界面切换 ：所有界面元素支持中文/英文切换
- 快捷键支持 ：
  - [ - 打开单词学习界面
  - ] - 打开复习界面
  - \ - 打开错题本
  - T - 切换界面语言
  - 空格 - 显示/隐藏答案
  - L - 标记为已学会
  - E - 标记为未学会
  - Q - 关闭界面
### 4. Interface and Interaction
- Beautiful GUI Design ：Semi-transparent background frames, colorful text, animation effects
- Chinese/English Interface Switching ：All interface elements support Chinese/English switching
- Shortcut Key Support ：
  - [ - Open word learning interface
  - ] - Open review interface
  - \ - Open error book
  - T - Toggle interface language
  - Space - Show/hide answer
  - L - Mark as learned
  - E - Mark as not learned
  - Q - Close interface
### 5. 数据管理
- 自动保存 ：学习进度和错题本自动保存到配置文件
- 统计信息 ：实时显示已学会单词数量和错题数量
- 数据持久化 ：重进游戏后学习进度保持不变
### 5. Data Management
- Automatic Saving ：Learning progress and error book are automatically saved to configuration files
- Statistics ：Real-time display of the number of learned words and error words
- Data Persistence ：Learning progress remains unchanged after re-entering the game
## 玩法说明
## Gameplay Instructions
1. 开始学习 ：在游戏中按下 [ 键打开单词学习界面
2. 查看单词 ：界面会显示一个随机单词及其音标和词性
3. 显示答案 ：按空格键或点击"显示/隐藏"按钮查看中文翻译和详细信息
4. 标记状态 ：
   - 点击"已学会"或按 L 键将单词标记为已掌握
   - 点击"未学会"或按 E 键将单词加入错题本
5. 继续学习 ：标记后系统会自动加载下一个单词
6. 复习巩固 ：按下 ] 键打开复习界面，浏览已学会的单词
7. 查看错题 ：按下 \ 键打开错题本，重点复习未掌握的单词
8. 切换语言 ：点击"中/EN"按钮或按 T 键切换界面语言
9. Start Learning ：Press [ in the game to open the word learning interface
10. View Word ：The interface will display a random word with its phonetic transcription and part of speech
11. Show Answer ：Press Space or click the "Show/Hide" button to view Chinese translation and detailed information
12. Mark Status ：
    - Click "Learned" or press L to mark the word as mastered
    - Click "Not Learned" or press E to add the word to the error book
13. Continue Learning ：The system will automatically load the next word after marking
14. Review and Consolidate ：Press ] to open the review interface and browse learned words
15. View Errors ：Press \ to open the error book and focus on reviewing unmastered words
16. Switch Language ：Click the "中/EN" button or press T to toggle interface language
## 特色亮点
## Highlights
- 无缝融入游戏 ：不影响正常游戏体验，随时可开启学习
- 丰富的词库 ：包含大量Minecraft相关词汇和常用英语单词
- 智能学习 ：基于学习状态自动调整推荐单词
- 视觉友好 ：美观的界面设计，减轻学习疲劳
- 操作便捷 ：丰富的快捷键和直观的按钮布局
- 数据安全 ：自动保存学习进度，防止数据丢失
- Seamless Integration with Game ：Does not affect normal game experience, learning can be started at any time
- Rich Vocabulary ：Contains a large number of Minecraft-related vocabulary and common English words
- Intelligent Learning ：Automatically adjusts recommended words based on learning status
- Visual Friendly ：Beautiful interface design to reduce learning fatigue
- Convenient Operation ：Rich shortcut keys and intuitive button layout
- Data Security ：Automatically saves learning progress to prevent data loss
## 适用人群
## Target Audience
- Minecraft玩家想要在游戏中学习英语
- 英语学习者寻找有趣的学习方式
- 教育工作者希望将游戏与学习相结合
- 任何对英语学习感兴趣的玩家
- Minecraft players who want to learn English in the game
- English learners looking for interesting learning methods
- Educators who want to combine gaming with learning
- Any player interested in English learning
